idea-plugin.name: Create MCP
idea-plugin.description:
Auto-generates custom Python Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers from any codebase.
Simply right-click a folder in your Project Explorer, select Create MCP Server, and it will automatically analyze your controllers/routers (Express, FastAPI, Flask, Django, Spring Boot) and synthesize a fully functional local MCP server!

action.description: Generates a customized Python MCP server from the selected folder
